concepts.summary: Play action off Weezy Madison Lick or P15 Willie. The tagged man runs Strike, a 10-yd route in 7 steps that bends to find the hole in the coverage. The other outside man gets the deep tag: Blink at 20, Swirl at 10 and 15, Blast at 20 with 10 and 15 marks, or a Streak with a Comeback alert in the Willie cell. The back's Lick Flat at 3 to 5 and the Check Flat are the outlets. The back stays in the fake and does not abort for a backside secondary blitz, except in the Willie cell where he has it.
concepts.progression: 1 Strike, 2 deep tag (Blink, Swirl, Blast or Streak), 3 Lick Flat or Check Flat
concepts.qb: 7 steps off the fake (7 or 5 in the Swirl cell). Strike bends into the open window.

positions.tagged: Strike at 10 yds in 7 steps, bend and find the hole (X or Z)
positions.other outside: Blink at 20 yds; Swirl at 10 and 15 yds; Blast at 20 yds with 10 and 15 marks; Streak with a Comeback alert at 18 (Willie cell)
positions.Y: Sift in the Willie and Blast cells
positions.F: Lick Flat at 3 to 5 yds, outlet
positions.H: Check Flat at 3 to 5 yds; stays in for the fake, no abort for a backside secondary blitz (has it in the Willie cell)

alerts: Streak with a Comeback alert at 18, outside release (Willie cell)
Back does not abort for a backside secondary blitz; in the Willie cell he has it

concepts.summary: Start adds a Stalk Rail: a receiver stalks like a run block and then rails up. Strike Start pairs it with Z on Strike (or Strike T.O.) at 10 in 7 steps and a Sift man who blocks first and can slip to the flat late; against a two-high look that slip is the hot throw. Start Basic is off Action 3 Jet with X on a Basic at 12 to 14, a Skinny T.O. at 10 in 7 steps and H on a Coin from a short Hover at 2 to 4. In this one the back aborts for the backside secondary blitz.
concepts.progression: Strike Start: 1 Strike, 2 Stalk Rail, 1 plus 3 for the sift outlet. Start Basic: 1 Stalk Rail, 2 Basic, 3 Skinny T.O., order unclear
concepts.qb: 7 steps. Check Wide alert in the Strike Start cell. Any two-high look makes the sift man slipping to the flat the hot throw.

positions.Z: Strike at 10 yds in 7 steps; Strike T.O. as the alert (Strike Start cell)
positions.stalk rail: Stalk then rail; the letter is unclear
positions.Y: Sifter: block first, late outlet to the flat (Strike Start cell)
positions.X: Basic at 12 to 14 yds (Start Basic cell)
positions.skinny: Skinny T.O. at 10 yds in 7 steps (Start Basic cell), letter unclear
positions.H: Hover at 2 to 4 yds, Coin (Start Basic cell); aborts for a backside secondary blitz (Strike Start cell)

formations: [11] SOUTH RT TOUT F SHORT HOVER
alerts: Two-high look: the sifter slipping to the flat is the hot throw
Back aborts for a backside secondary blitz

concepts.summary: Boot-style action off Grizzly Sucker or Staple with the QB on the move. X runs a Pylon at 15 (or Pylon Post) as the first read, Y crosses high at 18 to 22 between the numbers and the hash as the second, and a Flat plus a Late Flat from F are the outlets. Pitch puts Z on the Pitch with F on a Late Leak at 5.
concepts.progression: 1 Pylon or Pylon Post, 2 High Cross, 3 Late Flat; Flat is the outlet
concepts.qb: QB gets out on the move with the action.

positions.X: Pylon at 15 yds; Pylon Post when tagged
positions.Y: High Cross at 18 to 22 yds between the numbers and the hash
positions.F: Late Flat; Late Leak at 5 yds in the Pitch cell
positions.QB: on the move with the action

concepts.summary: Three deep play-action shots over a High Cross at 18 to 22. Blazer: X runs the Blazer as the first read with the High Cross second and the Check Flat third. Blush: X runs a Blink Stutter at 15 instead. Scorch: Z runs a Swirl T.O. at 15 and 10 off Weezy Madison Lick with a Lick Flat and a Bend. The back on Foam deepens his alignment, sells the fake and cleans up the edge.
concepts.progression: 1 Blazer, Blink Stutter or Swirl T.O., 2 High Cross, 3 Check Flat or Lick Flat
concepts.qb: 7 steps off the fake in the Scorch cell. Back does not abort for a backside secondary blitz (Scorch).

positions.X: Blazer (Blazer cell); Blink Stutter at 15 yds (Blush cell)
positions.Z: Swirl T.O. at 15 and 10 yds (Scorch cell)
positions.Y: High Cross at 18 to 22 yds between the numbers and the hash
positions.F: Lick Flat at 3 to 5 yds (Scorch cell)
positions.H: Check Flat at 3 to 5 yds; deepen alignment, sell the fake, clean up the edge (Foam cells)

alerts: Back: deepen, sell the fake, clean up the edge (Foam)
Back does not abort for a backside secondary blitz (Scorch)

concepts.summary: Throttle: the tagged man runs a 15-yd route that finds the void as the first read with a Field Post at 18 behind it and the Check Flat third. Safe: X runs the Field Post at 18 first, a Swirl at 10 and 15 second, a Flat third, with a Late Leak at 5 from F. The Willie cell adds F on a Blast Read It at 20 with 10 and 15 marks.
concepts.progression: Throttle: 1 Throttle, 2 Field Post, 3 Check Flat. Safe: 1 Field Post, 2 Swirl, 3 Flat
concepts.qb: Read It: play the Blast off the coverage. Back deepens and sells the fake on Foam; does not abort on the Staple cell; the Willie cell shows a 6-man slide.

positions.tagged throttle: Throttle at 15 yds, find the void (X or Z)
positions.field post: Field Post at 18 yds (Y in the Throttle cells, X in the Safe cells)
positions.F: Late Leak at 5 yds (Safe cell); Blast Read It at 20 yds with 10 and 15 marks (Willie cell); Seal in the Staple cell
positions.H: Check Flat at 3 to 5 yds (2 to 3 yds in the Willie cell)

alerts: Alert printed on the Willie cell, target unclear
Back: deepen, sell the fake, clean up the edge

concepts.summary: Off Milf Frog or Milf Madison action. The tagged man runs Stroke, an 8-step route, as the first read with Z on a Locker at 20 as the second. Another receiver runs a Fly. The back deepens his alignment and sells the fake, then is a Check Flat at 3 to 5.

positions.H: Check Flat at 3 to 5 yds; deepen alignment and sell the fake

concepts.summary: Off Foam. X runs Blaze Out at 22 to 25 as the first read with the tagged man (F or Z) on a Locker at 20 as the second. The first cell adds a Waggle. The back deepens, sells the fake, cleans up the edge and then checks the flat at 3 to 5.
concepts.progression: 1 Blaze Out, 2 Locker; Check Flat outlet
concepts.qb: Back does not abort for a backside secondary blitz (first cell).

positions.H: Check Flat at 3 to 5 yds; deepen, sell the fake, clean up the edge

alerts: Alert printed on both cells, target unclear
Back does not abort for a backside secondary blitz

concepts.summary: Off Weezy Madison Lick. The tagged man runs Shake, a 5-step route, first; the other outside man runs a Locker at 20 second. Lick Flat at 3 to 5 and Check Flat are the outlets, with a Bend or Sift from the inside man. The back does not abort for a backside secondary blitz.
concepts.qb: 7-man slide printed. Locker is the alert.

positions.F: Lick Flat at 3 to 5 yds, outlet
positions.H: Check Flat at 3 to 5 yds; no abort for a backside secondary blitz

alerts: Back does not abort for a backside secondary blitz

concepts.summary: Dash: X runs a Pylon at 15 as the first read, a Dagger widens at 18 to 20 behind it, and a Waggle is third over the Check Flat. The Paddy Insert cell adds Z on an Insert Stalk Flat with H on a Check Over and a Deep Special alert. Dapper: X runs the Deep Special with the Dagger widening at 18 to 20 and a Sift inside.
concepts.progression: Dash: 1 Pylon, 2 Dagger, 3 Waggle. Dapper: 1 Deep Special, 2 Dagger
concepts.qb: Back deepens, sells the fake and cleans up the edge on Foam; has the secondary blitz in the Paddy Insert cell.

positions.X: Dash: Pylon at 15 yds; Dapper: Deep Special
positions.dagger: Dagger, widen, 18 to 20 yds (15 yd mark), letter unclear
positions.H: Check Flat at 3 to 5 yds (Foam cells); Check Over (Paddy Insert cell)

alerts: Back has the secondary blitz (Paddy Insert cell)

concepts.summary: Off Foam. Z runs Sailor at 15 as the first read with a Waggle third and the Check Flat as the outlet. The second read is a Blink Stutter at 15 in one cell and a Blazer in the other; which cell carries the Stutter tag is unclear from the text. The back deepens, sells the fake and cleans up the edge.
concepts.progression: 1 Sailor, 2 Blink Stutter or Blazer, 3 Waggle
concepts.qb: 7-step style shot off the fake; Check Flat is the outlet.

positions.second read: Blink Stutter at 15 yds in one cell, Blazer in the other, letter unclear
positions.H: Check Flat at 3 to 5 yds; deepen, sell the fake, clean up the edge

concepts.summary: Off P12 or P13 Dime action with the QB reversing out. The tagged man runs Boat, a Sail at 12 and 15, as the first read; a Fly Wide is second and the Basic at 12 to 14 is third. H checks over and the Check Flat is the outlet at 5. Blazer widening is the alert. Skipper swaps in a Pylon Post, Captain a Pylon. The back has the secondary blitz.
concepts.progression: 1 Sail, 2 Fly Wide, 3 Basic; Blazer is the alert; Check Over and Check Flat are outlets
concepts.qb: Reverse out with the Dime fake.

positions.tagged: Sail at 12 and 15 yds (Y, or F on Skipper)
positions.basic: Basic at 12 to 14 yds (X, or Y on Skipper)
positions.H: Check Over; Check Flat; has the secondary blitz; Flat when tagged H Flat

concepts.summary: Rail concepts off P12 Dime Flock or Punch Flight with the QB reversing out. A Fly Rail is the first read, the Special is the alert, a Clear and a Widen Go open the deep middle, and the Check Flat at 3 to 5 is the outlet. Scale Rail adds a Skinny in 7 steps and Y on a Scout Burst: a Scout in 6 steps that widens and fades vs cloud, with H on a Check Burst.
concepts.progression: 1 Fly Rail, 2 Skinny or Clear, 3 Scout or Widen Go, order unclear; Special is the alert

positions.clear: Clear and Widen Go (Special Rail cell)
positions.Y: Scout Burst: Scout in 6 steps, widen, fade vs cloud (Scale Rail cell)
positions.H: Check Flat at 3 to 5 yds (Special Rail); Check Burst, outlet at 5 yds (Scale Rail)

concepts.summary: Off P12 Punch. Gronk is a Rip at 8 to 10 as the first read with a Skinny at 10 in 7 steps and a Go above it. C.O. puts a receiver on a C.O. at 5 as the second read. Start swaps in a Stalk Rail and makes the Skinny a Skinny T.O. H is the Check Flat at 3 to 5 off a 6-man slide and the alert outlet.
concepts.progression: 1 Rip, 2 C.O. or Stalk Rail; alert outlet
concepts.qb: 6-man slide printed. Flow tag listed in the title.

positions.rip: Rip at 8 to 10 yds, letter unclear
positions.skinny: Skinny at 10 yds in 7 steps; Skinny T.O. in the Start cell
positions.H: Check Flat at 3 to 5 yds; alert outlet

concepts.summary: Two leak plays. Bleach, off Grizzly Sucker: F leaks out late while X runs a Locker at 20 and Z a Blazer, with H to the flat. Leak, off Laker Pin: Y leaks under the linebackers after a pin block, a Low Cross at 10 to 12 is the first read, a Skate and the Flat are the outlets, and the QB gets depth and runs if nothing is there.
concepts.progression: Leak: 1 Low Cross, 2 Leak. Bleach: 1 Blazer, 2 Leak or Locker, order unclear
concepts.qb: Leak cell: get depth and run if it is covered.

positions.F: Bleach: Leak; Leak cell: Pin then release
positions.X: Locker at 20 yds (Bleach); Low Cross at 10 to 12 yds (Leak cell, letter unclear)
positions.Y: Leak under the linebackers (Leak cell); Skate tag

concepts.summary: Off Paddy. Z runs Halo, a High Cross at 18 to 22 between the numbers and the hash, as the first read and a Stalk Shallow at 5 is second: the stalker stays on the move for a 2 count before releasing. H is a Check Thru at 5 off a 7-man slide and the back has the secondary blitz. A Pylon Post is the alert; the X PP cell shows a Blazer label.
concepts.progression: 1 High Cross, 2 Stalk Shallow; Check Thru outlet; Pylon Post alert
concepts.qb: 7-man slide. Back has the secondary blitz.

positions.Z: Halo: High Cross at 18 to 22 yds between the numbers and the hash
positions.stalk shallow: Stalk Shallow at 5 yds, stay on the move for a 2 count, letter unclear
positions.X: Pylon Post alert; PP tag; Blazer label in the X PP cell, unclear
positions.H: Check Thru at 5 yds; has the secondary blitz

concepts.progression: 1 High Corner, 2 T.B.; Check Flat outlet
concepts.qb: 10-man number printed by H, meaning unclear.

positions.X: Retro: High Corner at 18 to 20 yds
T.B. at 10 to 12 yds with a 15 yd mark, letter unclear

concepts.summary: Boot-style action off Grizzly Staple, Grizzly Pin, Laker Pin or Laker Flock Pin. HP is a 15-yd route as the first read with a Low Cross at 10 to 12 second, H to the flat and F on a Late Leak at 5. Slacker adds a Slack at 4 to 6 with Y on Strike (10 yds, 7 steps). Smash and Settle (Fly Settle at 15) pair HP with X on Strike; Read It plays the HP off MOFC or MOFO. The QB gets depth and runs if it is covered.
concepts.progression: 1 HP, 2 Low Cross or Strike; Flat and Late Leak are outlets
concepts.qb: Get depth and run when the reads are covered. Read It: MOFC or MOFO decides the HP.

positions.X: HP at 15 yds (Staple and Pin cells); Strike at 10 yds in 7 steps (Smash and Settle cells)
positions.Y: Low Cross at 10 to 12 yds (Staple cell); Strike (Slacker cell)
positions.Z: Fly Settle at 15 yds (Settle cell); Pin (Smash cell), unclear
positions.F: Late Leak at 5 yds (Staple cell); Pin then release; HP Read It (Flock Pin cell)
positions.slack: Slack at 4 to 6 yds (Slacker cell), letter unclear
